assertions.name: sdp_bondgraph_degenerate
assertions.source: H₃ operator-selection LP-dual degenerate (y0*=0, active={γ}) at every target; free nucleon W_free=W_atom. Bond graph not SDP-derivable.

description: EXPLORATORY: the SDP-active-set route to the nuclear bond graph is degenerate (H₃ operator-selection LP-dual: y0*=0, only identity active, at every demand). A free nucleon has W_free=W_atom (no binding constraint). Neither the ad-hoc chain (k<A−1) nor the SDP derives the bond graph; coordination M_n(K) is an open geometric input (s5-so3). Corpus: he3_pairknot_composite_lp_probe + 2026-06-18 audit.
